destination.title: Weak gravity, black-hole bounds and neighboring diagnostics
destination.question: Under which assumptions do charged spectra, black-hole extremality, decay, relaxation and thermodynamics constrain weak-gravity proposals?
destination.summary: The original proposal supplies numerical membership without an authored scientific scope. Its connections are useful, but particle existence, black-hole charge ratios, repulsive forces, horizon retention and photon structures cannot be treated as interchangeable tests. Different systems and dimensions remain eligible within this broad family.

systems: Charged particles, branes and string spectra
Charged and rotating black holes in the specified gravitational theories
Thermal systems, compact-object geometries and observational comparison cases
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, asymptotics, coupling limits and perturbative orders
Extremal, near-extremal and nonextremal regimes kept distinct
assumptions: Conjectures and proposed connections remain questions or conditional inputs
Numerical selection roles do not determine scientific membership
A stationary horizon or photon sphere does not by itself establish a charged-particle spectrum or dynamical censorship
conventions: Particle and black-hole charge-to-mass ratios retain their source-specific normalizations
Relaxation-time definitions require explicit comparison before coefficients are identified
Singleton identities preserve exact source questions without asserting atomicity or cross-source uniqueness
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland relaxation, thermodynamic and geometric work
Alternate access to gravitational-wave consistency tests
excludes: Treating the numerical family as one equivalent scientific question
Universal validity inferred from selected models or announced results
Automatically identifying an RN reference ratio with extremality in a deformed theory

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture from Unitarity and Causality

evidence.text: Can unitarity and causality ensure that heavy extremal black holes satisfy the mild weak gravity conjecture, including when no charged particle satisfies its bound?

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Symmetries and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can black-hole discharge bounds on discrete Abelian gauge theories be understood through the WGC applied to a dual Abelian Higgs description, and can these constraints explain apparent weak-scale fine-tuning?

sources.title: NUT charge weak gravity conjecture from dimensional reduction

evidence.text: Do black-hole WGC bounds on four-derivative Wilson coefficients remain consistent under circle reduction, and does consistency require applying the WGC to higher-dimensional topological NUT charges?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and BPS Particles

evidence.text: Which charge directions have coincident BPS and black-hole extremality bounds, and what do the tower and sublattice WGC then require of BPS particles and holomorphic curves?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar CFT correlation functions and their relaxation poles imply weak gravity conjecture conditions for hyperscaling violating (HSV) and Kerr-Newman-AdS (KNA) black holes, particularly near extremality?

sources.title: RPS thermodynamics of Taub–NUT AdS black holes in the presence of central charge and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: How does restricted phase-space thermodynamics describe dyonic Taub–NUT–AdS black-hole criticality using central charge and chemical potential, and under what restrictions do the authors claim compatibility with a two-charge weak gravity criterion?

sources.title: The special role of toroidal black holes in holography

evidence.text: Under the paper’s WGC and censorship assumptions, must toroidal black holes emitted by extremely near-extremal parents be small in rH/L, and what would that imply for horizon-to-interior fall times and exterior thermal one-point functions?

sources.title: Newton vs Coulomb in <math display="inline"><mrow><mi>AdS</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>CFT</mi></mrow></math> and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: How does competition between gravitational attraction and electrostatic repulsion determine charged probe orbits in global RN–AdS, the binding energies of dual charged double-twist operators, and possible connections between WGC bounds and ISCO existence?

sources.title: Thermodynamic topology, photon spheres, and evidence for weak gravity conjecture in charged black holes with perfect fluid within Rastall theory

evidence.text: For charged black holes surrounded by the paper’s perfect-fluid environment in Rastall gravity, which parameters permit extremal Q/M > 1 together with a horizon and the proposed photon-sphere diagnostic, and what thermodynamic winding class do the selected solutions possess?

sources.title: Stability of Extremal Black Holes and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Kiselev Spacetime

evidence.text: How do small cosmological-constant-related perturbations affect extremal black-hole thermodynamics and WGC-based stability, and does charged-scalar scattering preserve entropy increase and weak cosmic censorship in quantum-corrected RN-AdS Kiselev spacetime?

sources.title: WGC as WCCC protector: The synergistic effects of various parameters in non-commutative black holes for identifying WGC candidate models

evidence.text: How do noncommutative smearing, Gauss–Bonnet coupling, charge and a string cloud affect horizons, photon spheres and timelike circular orbits, and can configurations retaining horizons at q/m>1 serve as candidates for studying WGC protection of WCCC?

sources.title: The computational complexity of the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the computational cost of constructing and testing Convex Hull WGC realizations scale with the number of Abelian gauge fields and supplied particle species? Can one efficiently identify a smallest particle subset realizing the condition?

sources.title: Beyond extremality: Weak Gravity Conjecture constraints on gravitational lensing in gravity’s rainbow

evidence.text: Can energy-dependent rainbow corrections reconcile charged black-hole extremality, WGC particle bounds and WCCC, and produce distinguishable weak-lensing signatures?

sources.title: Testing the weak gravity conjecture via gravitational lensing, black hole shadows, and Barrow thermodynamics in F(R)-Euler-Heisenberg (A)dS black holes

evidence.text: Can Euler–Heisenberg corrections in constant-curvature F(R) charged black holes support simultaneous WGC–WCCC compatibility, and connect that compatibility to lensing, shadows and Barrow thermodynamics?

sources.title: A Swampland-Modified Hod Bound for Charged Black Holes with Exotic Matter

evidence.text: How do quintessence and a string cloud modify charged-black-hole scalar relaxation and optical properties, and when can Hod's inequality and an adopted Swampland Distance Conjecture cutoff hold simultaneously?

sources.title: On Thermodynamics of Charged Black Holes, Swampland, and Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can charged-black-hole phase thermodynamics with a quasi-static scalar potential connect the weak gravity conjecture (WGC) and distance conjecture (DC), and motivate dark-dimension dark matter?

sources.title: Strongly-coupled black holes (are not) at weak coupling

evidence.text: When can local knowledge of moduli space exclude charged black hole flows to hidden attractors, including strongly coupled string regions, and thereby control the black hole spectrum entering the WGC?

sources.title: Renormalization group improved black holes in non-commutative momentum-dependent spacetime geometry

evidence.text: Can an imported non-commutative momentum-dependent geometry, connected to position through renormalization-inspired scale identification, yield quantum-improved Schwarzschild/RN thermodynamics and an extremal RN behavior interpreted as compatible with the weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Quantum-Corrected Deformation of RN-AdS Black Holes with a Cloud of Strings Immersed in Quintessential-like Fluid

evidence.text: How do a quantum-inspired deformation, a cloud of strings, and a quintessence-like fluid alter RN-AdS photon motion, shadows, neutral-particle circular orbits, and thermodynamic stability?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture from Unitarity and Causality

evidence.text: Forward helicity amplitudes are expanded in a spinning-polynomial factorization basis and matched at order s² to massive intermediate-state couplings. The construction assumes sufficiently mild ultraviolet growth and absolute convergence of the intermediate-state sum.

sources.title: Discrete Gauge Symmetries and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Euclidean black-hole thermodynamics sums vortex winding sectors in the fixed-temperature, fixed-charge ensemble. Aharonov–Bohm phases weight these sectors; k=±1 give leading charge-dependent corrections around k=0.

sources.title: NUT charge weak gravity conjecture from dimensional reduction

evidence.text: Uses KK reduction and identified STU-model fields to obtain the two-charge solutions. Four-dimensional electric/magnetic duality relates the two mixed-charge families, while reversing the dilaton and changing their five-dimensional uplifts.

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and BPS Particles

evidence.text: Use the attractor mechanism and fake-superpotential gradient flows for static, spherically symmetric black holes. A nonnegative sum-of-squares rewriting bounds the ADM mass, assuming suitable horizon behavior, and identifies extremal flow solutions.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Separate the minimally coupled charged Klein-Gordon equation into frequency, spatial momentum and radial factors. Solve the HSV radial equation using Whittaker functions at zero temperature and hypergeometric functions in the finite-temperature throat.

sources.title: RPS thermodynamics of Taub–NUT AdS black holes in the presence of central charge and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Criticality is located through (∂T/∂S)=0 and (∂²T/∂S²)=0 at fixed rescaled charges and C. The analysis uses Helmholtz energy F=M−TS, critical-value normalization of thermodynamic curves, and a small-NUT expansion for the μ–C processes.

sources.title: Kerr quasinormal modes and Hod's time-temperature bound

evidence.text: Does temperature impose a universal lower limit on relaxation time, and do near-extreme black holes attain its coefficient? The rate entering this question is the slowest relaxation rate of the system.

sources.title: From rotating to charged black holes and back again

evidence.text: Does imposing the mild charged Weak Gravity Conjecture on a nonrotating dyonic Kaluza–Klein black hole constrain higher-derivative corrections to rotating extremality bounds, and does this support a universal rotating WGC?

sources.title: Mutual influence of photon sphere and non-commutative parameter in various non-commutative black holes: Towards evidence for WGC

evidence.text: How does non-commutative mass smearing affect photon spheres and timelike circular orbits, and can these structures constrain model parameters or identify superextremal configurations relevant to the WGC?

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture for tidal Love numbers of black holes

evidence.text: Can the black-hole decay version of the Weak Gravity Conjecture constrain the tidal deformability of neutral black holes through shared higher-derivative Wilson coefficients?

sources.title: A New Spin on the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the mild WGC be expressed as an integrated effective-stress condition, can a spinning BTZ version follow from holographic RG flow, and can charged and spinning extremality constraints jointly restrict higher-derivative EFT coefficients?

sources.title: Can black holes cause cosmic expansion?

evidence.text: Could WGC-motivated repulsion between certain environmentally dressed charged black holes provide a weak auxiliary contribution to cosmic expansion while those objects retain horizons? The note explicitly does not seek to settle the separate black-hole dark-energy debate.

sources.title: Evidence for a sublattice weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Which lattice strengthening of the WGC survives compactification and string-theory tests, and what does the resulting charged tower imply for effective-field-theory cutoffs?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Must the lightest charged particle itself satisfy the macroscopic extremality ratio, and does that ensure a mass of order gM_Pl?

sources.title: The minimal weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: When must the WGC be satisfied by particles below the black-hole threshold, and when does consistency under circle reduction require a tower? Can a minimum meaningful circle radius allow finitely many super-extremal particles to satisfy the lower-dimensional convex hull condition (CHC)?

sources.title: Superradiant instability of charged extremal black holes in Einstein-Born-Infeld gravity

evidence.text: Does the Born–Infeld deformation make electrically charged extremal black holes superradiantly unstable to charged massive scalar perturbations for arbitrarily small coupling, and what does the instability imply for the proposed WGC decay mechanism?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a gravitational theory contain charged objects capable of discharging extremal black objects? The WGC answers through existence of suitable particles or branes below an extremality threshold, with BPS saturation allowed.

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can the weak-gravity inequality be required of the minimally charged state?

sources.title: Reissner-Nordström black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter: Testing the viability of weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship conjecture simultaneously

evidence.text: Can PFDM modify the horizon and extremality conditions of an asymptotically flat RN configuration so that Q > M remains compatible with the authors' Mild WGC criterion and with a singularity hidden behind a horizon?

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship and weak gravity conjectures in CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Under which critical-point parameter conditions can the authors' WGC charge-to-mass criterion coexist with a horizon-based WCCC criterion for RN-AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, using EPST, RPST and boundary CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Probing the weak gravity conjecture: Novel Aschenbach signatures in superextremal non-linear charged AdS black holes

evidence.text: Does an Aschenbach-like nonmonotonic orbital angular-velocity profile persist at and beyond extremality in a static nonlinear magnetically charged AdS solution of massive gravity, and can its photon-sphere structure offer evidence relevant to WGC and WCCC?

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Can RN-AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence and a string cloud satisfy the paper's weak-gravity charge-to-mass criterion while retaining a horizon at a restricted-phase-space thermodynamic critical point?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture in perturbative strings

evidence.text: Can universal worldsheet properties establish a sublattice WGC for perturbative strings, by constructing charged states, computing their long-range forces and relating self-repulsion to black-hole extremality?

sources.title: CFT constraints on the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can near-horizon correlator poles and a thermal damping-time bound yield WGC inequalities for dRGT and Einstein–ModMax black holes, and how do departures from extremality, minimal coupling, and two-derivative dynamics affect them?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Black Hole Entropy, and Modular Invariance

evidence.text: Can modular invariance connect light superextremal particles to the positive higher-derivative shift of extremal black-hole charge-to-mass ratios, thereby relating strong and mild forms of the Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: 2-2-holes simplified

evidence.text: Can a smoother metric formulation determine the interior, entropy and gravitational-wave travel time of arbitrarily large thermal 2-2-holes, and clarify their implications for black-hole-based WGC arguments?

sources.title: Confined monopoles and failure of the Lattice Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What underlies LWGC violation in theories that retain the sublattice WGC, and does confinement of fractional magnetic charges explain both the surviving superextremal sublattice and the severity of violation?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture validation with photon spheres of quantum corrected Reissner–Nordstrom–AdS black holes in Kiselev spacetime

evidence.text: Which parameter choices let the studied quantum-corrected charged AdS geometries retain an event horizon and an unstable photon sphere when Q > M, and can this coexistence support the authors’ proposed WGC/WCCC compatibility diagnostic?

sources.title: Reconciling the Weak Gravity and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjectures in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg-AdS Black Holes

evidence.text: Can electromagnetic nonlinearities produce Einstein–Euler–Heisenberg–AdS configurations with Qe>Me that retain horizons while satisfying the authors' particle charge-to-mass criterion for the WGC, and do photon-sphere diagnostics support the same parameter choices?

sources.title: Expanding the weak gravity conjecture in AdS space

evidence.text: How should the WGC constrain charged spectra in AdS with dynamical or stabilized moduli, and does preservation of the black-hole decay criterion under circle reduction motivate a tower WGC?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures for Strings and Membranes

evidence.text: How can WGC and force conditions be formulated for strongly backreacting low-codimension objects, and how do their properties constrain axionic metrics, infinite-distance limits and scalar potentials?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Which WGC formulation survives Higgsing, extends to discrete symmetries and low-codimension objects, and has sufficient nonsupersymmetric or holographic evidence?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture in Asymptotically Safe Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can running gravitational and electromagnetic couplings in asymptotically safe quantum gravity modify charged-black-hole extremality so that the Weak Gravity Conjecture emerges from ultraviolet renormalization-group behavior?

sources.title: ISCOs and the weak gravity conjecture bound in higher derivative theories of gravity

evidence.text: Can charged-probe binding energies and heavy-light CFT anomalous dimensions yield WGC bounds in higher-derivative AdS gravity, and does the disappearance of physical ISCOs coincide with those bounds?

sources.title: Dilatonic (Anti-)de Sitter black holes and Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How do charge, mass, dilaton coupling α and cosmological constant determine horizon existence, extremality and long-distance forces, and what dilatonic WGC bounds might these suggest?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and axion strings

evidence.text: Under what assumptions can mild p-form WGC statements imply a stringy charged tower and a cutoff near gM_Pl, rather than a Kaluza–Klein tower with local QFT valid to higher energies?

sources.title: Repulsive Forces and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: How should the superextremality-based WGC and long-range Repulsive Force Conjecture be distinguished with multiple photons and massless scalars, and could a stronger principle imply both?

sources.title: Mass and force relations for Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton black holes

evidence.text: Do long-range interactions between non-identical extremal dyons have generic dependence on dilaton coupling, correlated with binding energy and extremal mass geometry? The motivation includes probing the Repulsive Force Conjecture beyond self-forces.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture in ModMax black holes: weak cosmic censorship and photon sphere analysis

evidence.text: Can ModMax black holes retain horizons and unstable photon spheres when their charge exceeds the RN reference bound Q/M=1, and how do an AdS radius and constant-curvature F(R) corrections affect the authors' proposed WGC–WCCC compatibility?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture in de Sitter Space‐Time

evidence.text: How should the electric Weak Gravity Conjecture depend on positive cosmological constant if motivated by charged-black-hole decay without remnants, and can the resulting bound recover the flat-space WGC smoothly?

sources.title: The emergence of universal relations in the AdS black holes thermodynamics

evidence.text: Does a small constant deformation of the cosmological term reproduce entropy–extremality relations across selected AdS black holes, extend them to other thermodynamic conjugates, and support a WGC-like interpretation of corrected mass-to-charge behavior?

sources.title: The interplay of WGC and WCCC via charged scalar field fluxes in the RPST framework

evidence.text: How do charged scalar absorption and superradiance affect the second law, weak cosmic censorship conjecture (WCCC), and weak gravity conjecture (WGC) for RN-AdS black holes in restricted phase space thermodynamics?

sources.title: A proof of the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can the strict weak gravity inequality, requiring at least one charged particle with m/mP < q, be inferred from the generalized second law through a bound on black-hole relaxation?

sources.title: WGC and WCC for charged black holes with quintessence and cloud of strings

evidence.text: Under what restrictions can charged black holes surrounded by quintessence, with or without a cloud of strings, retain horizons when Q>M? The paper interprets these configurations as compatibility between its black-hole implementation of WGC and weak cosmic censorship.

sources.title: Proving the Weak Gravity Conjecture in perturbative string theory. Part I. The bosonic string

evidence.text: Does the tree-level spectrum of arbitrary perturbative bosonic strings satisfy the strict sublattice WGC, and can worldsheet forces supply the missing connection between spectral-flow states and black-hole extremality?

sources.title: Towards a proof of the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the electric U(1) WGC, qe>μ/M_P for at least one state, follow from a lower bound on thermalization time in the boundary description of near-extremal RN black holes, for both scalar and spin-1/2 probes?

sources.title: Sharpening the Weak Gravity Conjecture with Dimensional Reduction

evidence.text: Is the WGC preserved under toroidal compactification and scalar stabilization, what strengthening accommodates KK photons, and how far can black-hole extremality arguments extend to axions?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a supersymmetric theory still require a strict WGC inequality for particles? The N=1 four-dimensional example lacks the relevant charged-particle BPS saturation, despite supersymmetry of the ambient theory.

sources.title: Near-Extreme Black Holes and the Universal Relaxation Bound

evidence.text: Can canonical Kerr black holes analytically attain the proposed universal relaxation bound τ ≥ ℏ/(πT) in the extremal limit, using perturbations with large azimuthal number?

sources.title: Conformal field theories dual to quantum gravity with strongly coupled matter

evidence.text: Compute a covariant derivative of an OPE coefficient on the conformal manifold using the regularised integral of a connected four-point function. At leading large N, the required integrand is determined by Wick contractions of O and χ.

sources.title: Large N field theories, string theory and gravity

evidence.text: Approximate the string partition function by the exponential of the classical on-shell supergravity action. Expand in boundary sources to compute correlators using tree diagrams and bulk-to-boundary propagators; absorption calculations provide another route through two-point functions and the optical theorem.

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: OPE and conformal-partial-wave decomposition, descendant counting, and perturbative bootstrap in g=1/√c. The explicit scalar contact/exchange diagram expansions in Appendix B specialize to d=4 and AdS5.

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How can source-free scalar behavior and regular horizon electrostatics be imposed efficiently in a nonlinear holographic boundary problem?

sources.title: Baby universes in string theory

evidence.text: What do the O(e^−N) corrections that spoil large-N holomorphic factorization of two-dimensional Yang–Mills mean in the dual black-hole geometry, and can their baby-universe interpretation preserve quantum coherence?

sources.title: Holography vs. Scale Separation

evidence.text: Can parametrically scale-separated AdS admit a holographic CFT obtained by decoupling a string-theory brane, and what asymptotic scalar-potential condition does this require?

sources.title: Disorder averaging and its UV discontents

evidence.text: When can multiple holographic QFT sectors be interpreted through one effective AdS geometry?

sources.title: Holographic complexity in string and M theory

evidence.text: How should holographic complexity be formulated in full string/M-theory dualities, related to lower-dimensional AdS functionals, and constrained by higher-dimensional gauge invariance?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Do the field-theory and holographic calculations agree when branches, dictionaries, and counterterm schemes describe the same deformed sphere theory?

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can asymptotic symmetries and scalar boundary correlators support a holographic description of de Sitter quantum gravity by a Euclidean CFT, determine its central charge in three dimensions, and explain how bulk time and the two asymptotic boundaries are encoded?

sources.title: Strong Coupling Holography

evidence.text: Does the bulk holographic scale for N species constrain the strong-coupling scale of their four-dimensional brane theory, including limits that decouple gravity and examples without an AdS near-horizon geometry?

sources.title: No Forbidden Landscape in String/M-theory

evidence.text: Does holographic consistency exclude string/M-theory backgrounds dual to scale-invariant but nonconformal field theories, and can this exclusion constrain compactifications and higher-derivative effective actions?

sources.title: Micromanaging de Sitter holography

evidence.text: Can uplifting Freund-Rubin AdS/CFT constructions provide microscopic realizations of metastable de Sitter holography and account for the parametric scaling of Gibbons-Hawking entropy?

sources.title: Non-relativistic holography from Horava gravity

evidence.text: What bulk gravitational field content and gauge symmetries can holographically represent generic nonrelativistic QFTs with conserved particle number, and can the resulting dictionary reproduce the correlation-function structure required by nonrelativistic conformal symmetry?

sources.title: Discrete scale invariance in holography revisited

evidence.text: Does the proposed six-dimensional bottom-up holographic model genuinely reduce continuous conformal symmetry to Poincaré symmetry plus discrete scale invariance, or does its exact solution retain hidden continuous isometries? Can a more general warped ansatz separate scale from conformal invariance?

sources.title: The Holographic bound in anti-de Sitter space

evidence.text: How does AdS/CFT implement the holographic information bound, beyond identifying a gravitational bulk theory with a boundary theory, when both boundary area and boundary entropy are initially infinite?
